tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Snowman C400 Double FAN 120mm CPU Cooler is a high-performance tower air cooler designed to keep your Intel or AMD processor running at optimal temperatures. Equipped with 4 direct-contact copper heat pipes and dual 120mm RGB PWM fans, it efficiently dissipates heat while maintaining quiet operation. Its aluminum fin tower design maximizes airflow, making it an excellent cooling solution for gaming PCs, workstations, and high-performance desktop systems. The RGB lighting enhances your PC's appearance, while PWM fan control automatically adjusts fan speed for the perfect balance of cooling and noise. Snowman C400 supports a wide range of Intel and AMD CPU sockets, making it a versatile upgrade for modern computer builds. Typical specifications for this class of Snowman C400 cooler include four copper heat pipes, dual 120 mm PWM fans, support for mainstream Intel and AMD sockets, and cooling capacity around 130 W TDP.


Key Features


  • Dual 120mm RGB PWM cooling fans for enhanced airflow
  • 4 direct-contact copper heat pipes for rapid heat transfer
  • Tower heatsink with high-density aluminum fins
  • Quiet hydraulic bearing fans for low-noise operation
  • PWM intelligent fan speed control
  • RGB lighting for an attractive gaming setup
  • Supports Intel and AMD platforms
  • Ideal for gaming PCs, content creation, and everyday computing
